name: optimizer-v0-confirm-v1
selection: Compare final full validation at the declared 128,000-position horizon. Paired seeds/minibatches. Retain all three optimizers and failures; no single best checkpoint selection. Original screen used 32,000 exposures.
rationale: Seed-1 six-rate screen suggests 0.01 over 0.003; reducing bias rate to 0.01 at global 0.03 preserves many more edge gradients and improves the fixed-slice value loss. Confirm both candidates against the original optimizer with longer paired runs.
qualification: All 44 Rust and 50 Python checks pass; scaled Adam has full Rust/TPU parity. No new forward equation.
execution: Start from initialization with a common immutable environment. Three operational waves on released 24-core CPU lanes; waves do not change numerical settings. Launch after the eight-model full-validation workers leave those lanes.
conclusion: Validation gain alone is not a playing-strength or connectome advantage claim.
